AI tools are no longer just chatbots.

This week another frontier model shipped with better reasoning and longer memory. For small businesses in Pakistan, the real question is not "which model is best?" but "which boring task can I automate this month?"

2. Turning meeting notes into tasks automatically
3. Drafting weekly social media posts from industry news

Start with one workflow, measure the hours saved, then scale.
